note: ADR-0298 §3 debt baseline. Two maps, both SHRINK-ONLY — the gate fails on anything NEW. `instanceScopePresence` records DECLARED owners that register from a constructor or a mount function, so the isolation audit cannot prove that their absence at runtime is clean. `undeclaredStateCandidates` records files holding module-level project-scoped state with NO declared owner, found by the heuristic sweep in check-declared-project-scopes.ts. This list is the point of the exercise: every entry is a subsystem that could carry Project A's state into Project B today, and until now none of them was written down anywhere. Entries are triaged, not excused — LEAK-RISK entries need a declared owner; NOT-PROJECT-SCOPED entries need only a rename or a one-line confirmation to be removed.

instanceScopePresence.site.model: Registered inside installSiteProjectScope(), called once from initScene.ts. Closes by moving registration to module scope in siteProjectScope.ts (the store is resolved lazily from window.runtime already, so nothing blocks it).
instanceScopePresence.site.dispatch: Same call site as site.model; closes with the same move.
instanceScopePresence.site.neighbourFootprints: Same call site as site.model; closes with the same move.
instanceScopePresence.gis.cesiumViewport: Registered in the CesiumViewport CONSTRUCTOR (CesiumViewport.ts:1419/1425). THIS IS THE ENTRY THE FOUNDER'S 096e12b4 LOG HIT: the globe was never constructed in that session, so the switch teardown found no owner and could not tell that from a viewport whose registration had been skipped. Closes by keeping a module-level set of live viewports and registering ONE module-level probe that folds over it — absence then means 'the module never loaded', which provably holds nothing. Owned by the Cesium/PRYZM-Earth agent; routed, not taken.
instanceScopePresence.gis.areaLayout: Registered at the end of mountGISArea() (GISAreaLayout.ts:4664/4668) — a ~4500-line function, so any earlier return skips registration while the closure state stays live. Closes with a module-level presence delegate assigned by mountGISArea.
